messages.settings.note.clipboard_read: What each tier does: deny and over-limit both reply with a single empty response, no prompt and nothing to find on screen; changing the tier takes effect immediately for every live tab; ask asks once per read request (a session can hold at most 8 pending reads, any further request is answered as deny).
messages.settings.note.link_confirm: The two keys each cover one source: osc8 is a target the program declared explicitly, heuristic is a string guessed from its shape. ask_once remembers scheme + host + port, so a second link in the same domain is not asked about again, but a different port is.
messages.settings.note.link_schemes: Comma separated; links outside the allowlist are not drawn as clickable (an empty or all-invalid list means nothing is clickable)
messages.settings.note.quick_terminal: When enabled the window becomes frameless and always on top, shown and hidden by a global hotkey; enable and hotkey take effect after a restart, while the anchor, both ratios and hide-on-focus-loss apply at the next summon
messages.settings.note.serial: The entry landed before its consumer: the serial connection family is not built yet, so this group only reaches disk
messages.settings.note.session_log: Capability gate: even with this on, each session must still start its log explicitly. Old files in the log directory are neither cleaned nor rotated in this phase.
messages.settings.note.shortcuts: The entry landed before its consumer: key rebinding is not built yet, so bindings in the override table do nothing
messages.settings.note.ssh: The entry landed before its consumer: the SSH connection family is not built yet, so this group only reaches disk
messages.settings.note.ssh_algorithms: Comma-separated; a non-empty list replaces the library defaults. Legacy algorithms (e.g. ssh-rsa, diffie-hellman-group14-sha1) weaken security; enable only for old devices
messages.settings.note.status_bar: Seven of these ten already feed the status bar; the consumers of reconnect, cursor position and input latency are not built yet, so switching those three off only reaches disk
